After I rest for a few hours, the symptoms improve a lot.

turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I don’t usually feel like I have to rush to the bathroom or urinate urgently when my bladder isn’t full. My main issue has been the double vision and the muscle weakness that improves after resting.

turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t noticed any small, firm bumps on my skin that are smooth to the touch. My symptoms are mainly the double vision and the weakness with activity that improves after a few hours of rest.

turns.patient_answer: Patient: No, I haven’t been having trouble cooling down or feeling overheated—if anything, it’s mainly the double vision and the weakness that worsen with activity and then improve after I rest.
